chain.label: Combustible PVC oxygen hose made electrically conductive by internal coil spring
chain.trigger: The manufacturer of the PVC flexible oxygen hoses installed a stainless steel coil spring in the hoses ... loosely attached to the aluminum fittings at each hose end, making the hoses electrically conductive.

chain.label: FAA did not mandate replacement with nonconductive hoses after Boeing identified the hazard
chain.trigger: the FAA's review of Boeing's SBs ... missed the importance of this safety issue for undetermined reasons and thus did not result in the issuance of ADs

caused_by.evidence: Boeing had received previous reports of electrical energy causing leaks in oxygen hoses ... and began installing nonconductive hoses on new-production airplanes

chain.label: Electrical wiring installed above and in direct contact with oxygen supply tubing
chain.trigger: installations ... were found to have electrical wiring that was routed above and in direct contact with the oxygen tubing, even though the supplemental type certificate provided for positive separation

chain.label: No positive separation and no ground straps between wiring and conductive oxygen components
chain.trigger: the lack of positive separation between electrical wiring and electrically conductive oxygen system components ... the path of least resistance between the supplemental oxygen system and the airplane structure was through the hoses

caused_by.evidence: This routing created the potential for electrical short circuits to reach the flexible oxygen hoses.

chain.label: Short circuit from adjacent wiring energized the coil spring inside a supernumerary oxygen hose
chain.trigger: a short circuit from electrical wiring was the most likely source to energize the coil spring inside a supernumerary oxygen system hose

caused_by.evidence: The lack of positive separation allowed a short circuit to breach a combustible oxygen hose

chain.label: Energized spring ignited the PVC hose, which burst and released oxygen, feeding an intense fire that spread
chain.trigger: the design of the oxygen hose assembly allowed the internal spring to become a source of ignition when it was electrically energized, the PVC hose material to act as a fuel, and the oxygen within the hose to promote burning

caused_by.evidence: the fire ... most likely began when a combustible and electrically conductive oxygen hose in the supernumerary compartment became energized
Although SB 767-35A0034 was not initially accomplished on the accident airplane
which caused the hose to ignite and burn through, and ... the release of oxygen from the hose caused adjacent materials to ignite and burn at an accelerated rate

chain.label: L1 and R1 door mechanisms melted, rendering both forward doors inoperable
chain.trigger: The operating mechanism for the L1 door and the tracks for both doors ... had melted away, causing the doors to be inoperable.

caused_by.evidence: The L1 and R1 doors were extensively fire damaged.

chain.label: ARFF driver had only familiarization training on the HRET skin-penetrating nozzle
chain.trigger: the driver of Rescue 49 stated that he received familiarization training on the use of the HRET/SPN when the vehicle was delivered to SFO (about 14 years before the accident)

chain.label: Initial SPN application sprayed extinguishing agent outside the airplane
chain.trigger: he tried to insert the SPN through the right cockpit window but ... the extinguishing agent had sprayed outside, rather than inside, the airplane

caused_by.evidence: the type of training that the driver of Rescue 49 received on the operation of the HRET/SPN was not sufficient to allow him to successfully insert extinguishing agent into the cockpit on his initial attempts

chain.label: Airplane substantially damaged by fire; hull loss
chain.trigger: ABX Air reported that the substantial damage to the airplane resulted in a hull loss.

caused_by.evidence: initiate a fire in the supernumerary compartment that rapidly spread to other areas
ARFF personnel could not immediately access the fire because they were unable to open the L1 and R1 doors as a result of fire damage
the fire was contained about 2241:04, about 25 minutes after the first ARFF vehicle had arrived

chain.label: Both pilots evacuated through the cockpit window exits without injury
chain.trigger: Because of the location and the intensity of the fire, the flight crew had to evacuate the airplane through the two cockpit window exits ... and were not injured
